mapper.insert: insert into dws_daily_package_all_lab_login (dates, pkg, version, config_group_type, config_group_name, user_num) select dulr.dates, dulr.pkg, dulr.version, dul.config_group_type, dul.name config_group_name, count(DISTINCT dulr.user_id) user_num from dwd_user_login_record dulr INNER JOIN dim_user_lab dul on (dul.user_id = dulr.user_id) where dulr.dates = #{dates} group by dulr.dates, dulr.pkg, dulr.version, dul.config_group_type, dul.name
